schedulers.lavd: Latency-criticality aware; aimed at gaming and interactive desktop use.
schedulers.bpfland: Prioritises interactive tasks to keep the desktop responsive under load.
schedulers.flash: Deadline-based; aims at predictable latency for audio and real-time work.
schedulers.rustland: Scheduling policy implemented in user space; experimental.
schedulers.tickless: Reduces timer ticks; aimed at servers and virtualised workloads.
